rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken equivalent for saying that something is improbable or not reasonably expected.

example.english: It's unlikely that this project will be finished this year.
example.traditional: 呢個計劃今年完成，唔大可能。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 gam1 nin4 jyun4 sing4 m4 daai6 ho2 nang4

rows.note: Use this when judging that a person or event does not seem likely to carry out a future action.

example.jyutping: keoi5 m4 ci5 wui5 lai4 wo3

rows.jyutping: V ge3 gei1 wui6 m4 daai6
rows.note: Use this when framing the unlikely event in terms of its chances being low.

example.english: We are unlikely to win this time.
example.traditional: 今次我哋贏嘅機會唔大。
example.jyutping: gam1 ci3 ngo5 dei6 jeng4 ge3 gei1 wui6 m4 daai6
